name: When You Gain a Level
summary: 1. Increase maximum HP using your class Hit Die. 2. Increase proficiency bonus if the new level crosses a proficiency threshold. 3. Gain the class features listed for the new level. 4. If the level grants an Ability Score Improvement / Talent, choose one of those options according to the class rules. 5. Update attack modifiers, saving throw DCs, class resources and any feature that scales with level or proficiency bonus.
descriptionMarkdown:
1. Increase maximum HP using your class Hit Die.

5. Update attack modifiers, saving throw DCs, class resources and any feature that scales with level or proficiency 
bonus.
